Pedal Power Tuesday Night Mountain Bike Ride

Middletown, CT · Mountain bike

Pedal Power Tuesday Night Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Middletown, CT. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:45 pm from Middlesex (see the Ride Alert page).

For visitors

Sign Pedal Power's annual waiver. Dark by the end, bring lights. Check the Ride Alert page before you go.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual pace, advanced tech.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pedal Power Tuesday Night Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A fall mountain bike ride from the Middletown shop for intermediate and advanced riders. Casual pace, advanced technical trails. A waiver is required.
